name: 14225 · Cheektowaga, NY
findings: ZIP 14225 (Cheektowaga) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14225 (Cheektowaga) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
